description: Opens a new, empty NeuroVue window and returns its tab id, which the other tools take as tab to drive it.

useWhen: Compare datasets side by side, one per window.

avoidWhen.when: One window should show another dataset.

effects: Opens a window on the person's screen; it stays open until they close it.

failures.meaning: The window opened but has not reached the agent server yet.
failures.remedy: Call list_tabs in a few seconds and use the new tab once it is listed.
